$comment: Server-owned generation configuration. Like the retrieval configuration,
no client may override any of it: prompt, model, deployment, context size
and answer length all decide what the model is allowed to do, so changing
them is a reviewable diff rather than a request parameter.
context_budget_chars bounds the evidence block. When the budget is
exhausted only COMPLETE chunks are included; a chunk is never cut, because
a fragment reads as complete evidence while being partial.
